name.value: C Prime Modern Italian Steak & Wine

description.value: C|Prime is an upscale Italian restaurant and steakhouse situated just below the Century Plaza Hotel in downtown Vancouver, offering handmade pastas, prime-cut steaks, fresh seafood, and an extensive wine program spanning B.C. and international labels. Executive Chef Behshad Zolnasr trained at Michelin-starred kitchens in Rome, London, and New York before bringing that experience to Vancouver. The restaurant serves from breakfast through a late-night bar, making it a full-day dining option for cyclists passing through the Burrard Street corridor.
